about: Band cut-offs by prose length for BBBScorer 0.10.0 (tools/build_length_bands.mjs), as percentiles of 2023 cards (mostly human) of that length: Original below the 65th, Fresh to the 94th, Mixed to the 98th, Common from the 98th. From 350 prose words up, one set of cut-offs taken over all cards with 150+ prose words.
source: dev experiment rows (dev/analysis/band_rows_early2023.mjs) (score); left out 62 rows with old-school level strong
note: BBBScorer 0.9.3 scores of early-2023 collections (Pygmalion Discord, Roko's Basilisk, VenusAI, Chub mega; deduplicated), cards the lists were never mined from. ChatGPT-era cards (strong old-school level) left out of the human side; one shared set of cut-offs from 350 prose words up.
